editorialSummary.heading: Match the dismissal dates to your child’s school
paragraphs: A shortened school day in Clay County does not always apply to every grade. Elementary schools have six early-dismissal dates, beginning September 18. Junior high and high schools have six of their own, concentrated in the three days before Christmas break and the three final student days. Both groups leave early December 18 and May 27. April 23 combines elementary early dismissal with interim grades being posted; the reporting deadline does not shorten secondary classes.

Teacher planning also changes when families need care. October 12 is a student holiday after the first grading period ends. At Christmas, the named holiday ends January 1, but students remain out January 4 for planning and return January 5. In March, the planning day comes before spring break: March 19 joins the March 22-26 holiday and surrounding weekends. The published return is March 29.

Fair Day on April 2 is another student holiday, shortly after the spring return. Graduation is listed for May 21, six days before the final student day; the calendar does not list a separate last attendance day for seniors. Final report cards are posted June 4, after the regular school year has ended. Families should use school notices for ceremony details and pickup times.

faqs.question: When does the 2026-2027 school year start and end?
faqs.answer: The first student day is Tuesday, August 11, 2026, and the last is Thursday, May 27, 2027. May 27 has early dismissal for both elementary and secondary schools. The earlier August 3 and August 6 entries are for teachers.

faqs.question: Which dates have elementary early dismissal?
faqs.answer: Elementary dates are September 18, October 30 and December 18, 2026, and February 12, April 23 and May 27, 2027. The elementary list does not set the junior-high and high-school schedule.

faqs.question: When do junior high and high schools dismiss early?
faqs.answer: Secondary early dismissals are December 16, 17 and 18, 2026, and May 25, 26 and 27, 2027. Students attend on each date. Only December 18 and May 27 also appear on the elementary list.

faqs.question: What time should I pick up my child on an early-dismissal day?
faqs.answer: The annual calendar lists dates without dismissal times. The district’s 2026-2027 School Hours table gives regular student arrival and departure times, not shortened-day pickup times. Check your school’s notice and transportation arrangements for the date concerned.

faqs.question: Are school hours the same at every elementary campus?
faqs.answer: No. The 2026-2027 table lists most elementary schools at 8:30 a.m.-2:42 p.m. Rideout and Shadowlawn are 8:20 a.m.-2:32 p.m.; McRae is 8:45 a.m.-2:57 p.m.; Orange Park Elementary is 7:45 a.m.-1:57 p.m. These are student times, Eastern Time, not office hours.

faqs.question: What are the regular junior-high and high-school hours?
faqs.answer: The current 2026-2027 district table lists junior highs at 9:30 a.m.-3:42 p.m. and high schools, including Keystone Heights Jr/Sr High, at 7:20 a.m.-1:40 p.m. Bannerman has program-specific hours. The table does not establish shortened-day dismissal times.

faqs.question: Is there school on October 12?
faqs.answer: October 12, 2026 is a planning day and student holiday. Students are scheduled back Tuesday, October 13. The October 9 grading-period endpoint is not itself listed as a day off or an early dismissal.

faqs.question: Are students off for Labor Day and Veterans Day?
faqs.answer: Yes. Labor Day on September 7 and Veterans Day on November 11, 2026 are student and teacher holidays. Neither is an early-dismissal attendance day.

faqs.question: What are Thanksgiving break and return dates?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving holidays are November 23-27, 2026. With the surrounding weekends, that is nine consecutive days without regular classes. The scheduled return is Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: Do students return January 4 after Christmas break?
faqs.answer: No. Christmas/New Year’s break runs December 21, 2026-January 1, 2027. January 4 is a separate planning day and student holiday. The published student return is Tuesday, January 5.

faqs.question: When is spring break, and is March 19 a student holiday?
faqs.answer: March 19, 2027 is a planning day with no student classes. It connects with the March 22-26 spring break and weekends, giving students March 19-28 off continuously. The stated return is Monday, March 29.

faqs.question: Does Clay County have a Fair Day holiday?
faqs.answer: Friday, April 2, 2027 is Fair Day, a student and teacher holiday. It follows four scheduled school days after the March 29 spring return. It does not extend spring break through the whole following week.

faqs.question: Are students off for Martin Luther King Jr. Day and Presidents Day?
faqs.answer: January 18 and February 15, 2027 are student and teacher holidays. Each falls on Monday, with a scheduled Tuesday return after the long weekend.

faqs.question: When do the grading periods end?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists October 9 and December 18, 2026, March 18, 2027 and the May 27 last student day. December 18 and May 27 have early dismissal for elementary and secondary schools. The other grading endpoints are not marked as shortened days.

faqs.question: When are interim grades posted?
faqs.answer: Interim dates are September 11 and November 13, 2026, and February 5 and April 23, 2027. April 23 also has elementary early dismissal. The reporting date does not make it a secondary early-release day.

faqs.question: When are report cards posted, including the final report card?
faqs.answer: Report cards are posted October 16, 2026, January 11, March 31 and June 4, 2027. Students return from spring break March 29; the third report card follows two days later. The final June 4 posting is after the May 27 last student day and does not require students to return to class.

faqs.question: Where can parents see posted grades?
faqs.answer: The district’s current September and October notices direct families to Focus for posted grades and report cards. Use the district’s Focus information page for sign-in and account help.

faqs.question: Is graduation the last school day for seniors?
faqs.answer: The calendar gives graduation as May 21, 2027, but does not state a separate last attendance day for seniors. The district student year ends May 27. Graduating students should follow their school’s exam, rehearsal and checkout instructions.

faqs.question: How many instructional days are listed?
faqs.answer: The published grading-period figures are 43, 43, 51 and 43 days, which add to 180. The published dates also yield 180 attendance weekdays. The annual figure here is a calculation, not a separately printed annual total. Follow district notices for any later change.

faqs.question: Which days are reserved for weather make-up?
faqs.answer: The published calendar does not specify a make-up-day order or designate reserve holidays. Check district weather announcements for an actual adjustment rather than assuming that a holiday or shortened day has been converted.

faqs.question: Where is the official online calendar?
faqs.answer: Open “26-27 Student Calendar” on the district’s Student Calendars page. It is a Google document that can be printed or downloaded. The final calendar prints School Board approval on December 12, 2024. Check district and school announcements for later changes.

editorialSummary.heading: Allow for the planning day after spring break
paragraphs: The spring return is the date to watch in Clay County’s 2027-2028 schedule. The named holiday runs March 13-17, followed by the weekend and a March 20 planning day with no student classes. Students return Tuesday, March 21. Report cards follow March 24. These are different dates with different purposes: a return to school, a staff planning day and a reporting deadline should not be treated as interchangeable.

April brings two more Friday holidays. Fair Day is April 7 and Good Friday is April 14. The intervening Monday through Thursday are not listed as holidays, so the two Fridays do not make a continuous vacation. Elementary students then have early dismissal May 5. Junior high and high school students have their final shortened days May 24-26, while elementary students join them only on May 26.

Earlier in the year, both school groups leave early December 17 before Christmas break. The January 3 planning day delays the return until January 4. Graduation is listed May 19, and regular classes finish May 26. The final report-card posting is June 9. The annual schedule gives dates rather than ceremony or dismissal times, so keep school messages handy when arranging transport and graduation plans.

faqs.question: Which six dates have early dismissal for elementary schools?

faqs.question: What are the shortened days for junior high and high schools?

faqs.question: Are 2027-2028 early-dismissal times available in the calendar?

faqs.question: Is October 11 a student holiday?

faqs.question: When are Labor Day and Veterans Day school holidays?
faqs.answer: The holidays are Monday, September 6 and Thursday, November 11, 2027. Both are student and teacher holidays. November 12 is not listed as an extra holiday just because Veterans Day falls on Thursday.

faqs.question: How long is the Thanksgiving holiday?
faqs.answer: The listed student and teacher holidays run November 22-26, 2027. The surrounding weekends make a continuous November 20-28 break. Classes are scheduled to resume Monday, November 29.

faqs.question: When do students come back after Christmas?
faqs.answer: Christmas break is December 20-31, 2027. January 3, 2028 is a separate planning day and student holiday, so students return Tuesday, January 4. The preceding December 17 student day is shortened for both school groups.

faqs.question: When is spring break, and do students attend on March 20?
faqs.answer: Spring break runs March 13-17, 2028. Students remain out Monday, March 20 for a planning day, with a stated return Tuesday, March 21. Including the weekends, the continuous no-class stretch is March 11-20.

faqs.question: Are Fair Day and Good Friday one continuous April break?

faqs.question: Do Martin Luther King Jr. Day and Presidents Day close student classes?
faqs.answer: Yes. January 17 and February 21, 2028 are student and teacher holidays. The scheduled return after each Monday holiday is the following Tuesday.

faqs.question: What are the four grading-period end dates?
faqs.answer: The endpoints are October 8 and December 17, 2027, March 10, 2028 and May 26. December 17 and May 26 are early-dismissal days for elementary and secondary schools. A grading-period endpoint alone does not make October 8 or March 10 a shortened day.

faqs.question: When are interim grades available?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists September 10 and November 12, 2027, and February 4 and April 21, 2028. Those reporting dates are not listed as early-dismissal dates.

faqs.question: When will report cards be posted?

faqs.question: When is graduation, and does it change the last student day?
faqs.answer: Graduation is listed Friday, May 19, 2028. The annual calendar gives no separate senior last attendance day or school-by-school ceremony timetable. The regular district endpoint remains May 26. Confirm graduation arrangements and senior requirements with the high school.

There are 209 weekdays between the first and last student dates and 29 listed weekdays without classes, also yielding 180. The total is calculated from the published schedule and may change if the district revises the schedule.

faqs.question: Are any holiday dates designated as weather make-up reserves?
faqs.answer: No reserve-date list or activation order appears in the published calendar. A later district notice would be needed to establish a change. Follow district announcements for any later make-up arrangement.

faqs.question: Where can families open the official 2027-2028 calendar?
faqs.answer: Choose “27-28 Student Calendar” on the district’s Student Calendars page. It opens a Google document for viewing, printing or downloading. The final calendar prints School Board approval on November 6, 2025. Follow district and school announcements for changes after publication.

2027-2028.calendarScope: Clay County District Schools regular 2027-2028 student calendar. Elementary and junior-high/high-school early dismissals differ; the common final student day applies to both groups. Graduation is a separate milestone, and the final report-card posting follows the end of classes.
2027-2028.earlyReleaseStatisticExplanation: Ten unique early-dismissal dates across elementary and secondary schools. Each school group has six dates; only the December quarter-end and the final student day are shared. These are shortened attendance days, not ten districtwide closures.
